short_description:
GTA 6's fighter jets are at Mile Zero Air Station, the military base southeast of Key Lento. The jets park in the north half of the base; guides use a stunt jump at the southeast corner, on the southern access road, to get in. Expect a very high wanted level the moment you're inside. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

📍 Map Spot #22 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: PC Gamer, GTABase, Game8, The Click.

Los cazas de GTA 6 están en Mile Zero Air Station, la base militar al sureste de Key Lento, en la mitad norte. Las guías entran con un salto en la esquina sureste. Entrar da un nivel de búsqueda muy alto. Fuentes: PC Gamer, GTABase, Game8, The Click.
